title: Mai azadaar hu
body:
Mai azadar hu....(4)
Mai azadar hu..azadar hu..
Maksad e sheh se wafadar hu....
Mai azadar hu..azadar hu..(3)
Meri socho mein basa karbobala ka manzar
Gunjti ab bhi hai halmin ki sadae sarwar
Mai nahi bhul saka aaj talak ashura
Haye wo shame gharibaa me jala shaih ka ghar.
Mai usi ghar ka hi ghamkhaar hu.
Jo diya dars mere maula ne wakt e akhir
Momino aisa hi kirdaar banao zahir
Apne baatin me sajao yahi paigham e husain
Ho raza rab ki to bekhauf kata do ye sir
Isi manzil ka talabgaar hu.
Itna aasaan nahi khudko batana shiya
Qaul o guftaar ye qirdaar banao apna
Jaise qambar bane aur meesam e miqdad bane
Tum bhi kuch karke amal khudse dikhao aisa
Phir kaho inka mai hubdar hu..
Huqm e khaliq pe mai sajde me ye sar rakhta hu
Wakt par wajeebi har kaam ada karta hu
Dars ye aale mohammad ne diya hai humko
Jisse naaraaz ho wo kaam se mai darta hu
Shukr hai saahib e kirdaar hu
Meri maa ne mujhe bachpan se ye batlaya hai
Maine shabbir ke sadqe me tujhe paya hai
Tu mere paas amanat hai mere maula ki
Bas yahi sochke dil maa ka bhi ghabraya hai
Jaan dene ko mai taiyar hu
jo bhi likhta hu mai sab maula likhate hai mujhe
Khoon e shabbir ke saudo'n se bachate hai mujhe
Bas isi zikr ke sadqe me hai pehchaan meri
Warna mai kuch bhi nahi maula batate hai mujhe
naukar e saiyad e sardaar hu
Zeb deta nahi mujhko ye dikhawa karna
Zikr e shabbir se mimbar pe tamasha karna
Iski tehzeeb bhi taazeem bhi laazim mujhpar
be adab hoke hai is zikr se dhoka karna
Is sakhi ghar ka tarafdaar hu.
Marefat paane ki koshish me magan rehta hu
Waqt ke maula se har baat kiya karta hu
Aaj gumrah hui qaum meri markaz se
Dekhkar inki khurafaat mai rodeta hu
Inki rasmo se mai bezaar hu.
Mujhpe ghaibat me hai wajib hui taqleede imam
Jo bane naaeb e maula hai unhe mera salaam
Unka har hukm hai laazim ke mai tasleem karu
warna shiya hu mai khaali hi rahega ye kalaam
Hukme maula ka wafadar hu.
Maksad e hazrat e zainab pe amal karta hu
dushman e majliso matam se lada karta hu
Daure baatil me yahi kaam hai mera logo
Haq ki baatein mai ali deep diya karta hu
Dushmano ke liye mukhtaar hu.
Maksad e sheh se wafadar hu..
Mai azadar hu..azadar hu..
